dedupe_keys.name: ethos reskit renewable generation simulation toolkit

description: ETHOS.RESKit is Forschungszentrum Juelich's Python toolkit for generating renewable-electricity inputs to energy-system models. It simulates individual onshore or offshore wind turbines, photovoltaic modules and concentrating-solar systems from placements, equipment assumptions and gridded weather. Outputs are generation time series and related capacity factors. Spatial coverage follows the selected units; temporal coverage and resolution follow weather inputs. MIT source is free, while two published wind-correction data files use CC-BY-4.0. The toolkit supports synthetic wind power curves and national capacity-factor corrections. A limitation is that its current automated weather helper supports ERA5, with some atlas inputs still supplied manually. The pinned full-data catalogue lacks an ERA5 dataset even though bundled test fixtures work. RESKit can prepare renewable-generation scenarios for infrastructure capacity simulations. GLAES (platform-glaes) supplies related land-eligibility calculations. Documentation was reviewed, but no weather files or model software were downloaded.
